policies.text: A regional rail operator receives green railway certification when its yearly electrification ratio exceeds 80 percent.
A charter enterprise earns premier baggage service standing when its baggage misplacement rate is no greater than 0.5 percent this quarter.
A sea transport company achieves priority water carrier ranking provided its monthly on-time arrival rate reaches 90 percent or higher.
A carrier with first-level regulatory clearance gains approval for high-capacity city transit lines provided it holds an official passenger transit licence.
Allocation to the central express transit contract is open to any carrier with approval for high-capacity city transit lines.

A transit provider attains first-level regulatory clearance if it utilizes an automated driver fatigue monitoring system, completes at least 100 safety audits a year, and maintains an active fleet size of at least 20 vehicles.
A shipping firm gains clearance for international transport assignment when it maintains an active international freight permit.
An aviation vendor obtains priority slot reservation if its annual safety incident count remains below two.
